description: NSW Roads Traffic Volume Counts API is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport for NSW. Transport is aware that the Traffic Volume datasets have been experiencing issues with data quality and sensor availability. There is an initiative underway to rebuild this service, however this is an extensive task, and a timeline for completion has not yet been set. Coverage: Transport for NSW. The portal files it under the publisher Transport for NSW. Its tags are RMS, Traffic API, roads, roads information, roads planning. It offers 6 resource(s) in API, CSV, PDF, ZIP. The portal shows 2025-08-04 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
